job.title: Security Engineer, AWS Security
job.pay_full: $136,000 – $184,000 a year base salary (Austin), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: An application security (AppSec) role in Amazon Security. The engineer reviews service designs and architecture and runs deep-dive security assessments so that applications and services meet a high security bar before they launch, working alongside senior engineers to find issues, drive fixes and confirm security requirements are met. The team says candidates who don't meet every listed qualification, or whose careers are just starting, are encouraged to apply.
duties: Review the design of new and existing services, assessing architecture documents and system designs for security risks
Run structured threat modelling to find attack vectors and weaknesses in application architectures
Coordinate penetration testing to validate security controls and find exploitable vulnerabilities
Document, track and communicate findings to service teams with clear fix guidance, then verify the fixes
Advise development teams on secure coding, authentication and authorization, cryptography and data protection
Escalate high-severity issues so they are fixed in line with launch timelines
Keep clear records of review outcomes, security decisions and risk assessments, and use automated tools to make reviews more efficient
needs: 2+ years (non-internship) of experience with web protocols, common security attacks and remediation
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field
Knowledge of system security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques, including penetration testing and exploit development or equivalent
Experience solving basic problems by writing code or scripts with some assistance
nice: Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler), GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or Security+ certification
details.benefits: Base salary $136,000 – $184,000 a year (Austin, TX). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Employing entity: Amazon Development Center U.S., Inc.
Flexible work hours and arrangements are described as part of the team's culture
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
